created_prompt:
You are a top class creative strategist and publishing consultant. Generate a concrete and realistic three year growth plan for a content creator who works 4 days a week and posts videos to more than 1 million followers who love healthy and quick recipes. The goal is audience growth and the publishing of a cookbook. Budget and time are limited. 
The plan must include a detailed roadmap; content, growth and email-list strategies with a work schedule optimized for a four days week. Also include quarterly Kpis, generate a comparison (plus recommendations) of traditional versus self publishing & a (budget friendly!) launch plan for a cookbook. Make sure to highlight key risks, major decision checkpoints and the top 4 actions to start with.
Format the plan in the most convenient way possible, using tables (if useful), clear headings and integrating actionable tips and suggestions.
